nodes.title: Avionics parts on arrival: weigh, measure, confirm the CoreWing stack split
nodes.procedure: 0.01 g scale on every AVN part; calipers on FC board, airspeed board (incl. ports), RX, GPS, probe OD; confirm the FC top board runs from the power board on a cable (else fallback: whole stack on the PDB plate on gel cubes, 8 AWG leads with a 30 mm flex loop tied to the tray); record the connector positions for F2; update subsystems/avionics/params.json and re-run avn_data.py
